page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-8-lssd is an arm64-based server instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance does not include graphics processing units, with a GPU count of zero, and local storage is specified as None in the configuration data. It also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating on the arm64 architecture, this server family is designed for workloads requiring higher memory density per vCPU. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are not shared with other tenants, providing predictable execution times. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio allows memory-intensive applications to run without provisioning excess compute cores, optimizing resource utilization.

This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive workloads that do not require GPU acceleration or local storage. Suitable applications include in-memory databases, caching layers, data buffering, and memory-bound enterprise applications that benefit from the arm64 instruction set.
